title: Exorcism? Breakthrough? Duke rejuvenates season, exacts revenge against UConn
excerpt: What the Blue Devils did Wednesday represented an unburdening.
content:
What the Blue Devils did Wednesday represented an unburdening.

LAS VEGAS — Some might call it an exorcism. At minimum, a cathartic event. Bottom line: What Duke did to UConn here at T-Mobile Arena on Wednesday night, a 77-63 victory that answered so many questions about this season's team and avenged a haunting collapse to end last season against the Huskies, represented an unburdening.

It offered a primal release, sweet relief, from so many pent-up emotions, frustrations and the loud, relentless doubts about whether this loaded roster and its 39-year-old head coach actually have what it takes to turn talent into a trophy. 

If you don't think this meant more to the Blue Devils than perhaps any other November nonconference game possibly could, just listen to Jon Scheyer's opening remarks afterward.
